Enrich person.name: Eshan Kochar
Enrich person.title: AVP - Data, Insights & Workforce Management
Enrich person.summary:
Eshan is an accomplished business and technology leader with a wealth of experience in the financial services and contact center domains. He specializes in data analytics, transformation, technology implementation, and relationship management. 

As an innovative thinker, Eshan has developed unique data-driven strategies for businesses both as an external consultant and a full-time employee. He has a proven track record of delivering significant business value through improved client experiences, substantial savings, and revenue generation. Eshan's data domain knowledge includes data management, warehousing, engineering,  analytics and reporting both as a strategist and as an end-user.  

Eshan began his career in the outsourcing industry in India and has worked his way through a diverse range of industries, working with esteemed corporations such as RBC, Dell, GE, Capgemini, and Concentrix. 

Eshan is a boundary pusher who always looks for new and better ways to get things done and re-invent himself simultaneously. Before taking a voluntary sabbatical from RBC late last year, he led a dynamic team of data analysts, engineers, and scientists, transforming the contact center function into a powerful data analytics ecosystem. 

In his recent consulting role at Sunlife, Eshan helped the Business architecture team to plan and implement the Amazon Connect CCaaS (Contact-Center-as-a-Service) solution. He contributed to creating a CCaaS data and reporting readiness plan and developing a personalized client experience enablement strategy proposal.

Currently, Eshan is working on part-time consulting engagements, advising new and existing product teams in building client relationships within the Canadian financial services area. He actively seeks a full-time or consulting challenge in data, technology, or contact center domains.
